summary: Iteration 7: P1 features (Smart Access UI, Multi-sig withdrawals, Admin moderation tab, Regional Hubs shadcn Select). Backend multi-sig endpoints 100% passing (15/15). Found CRITICAL frontend bugs in AdminDashboardPage: pendingProducts is never fetched and handleModerate handler is undefined — so approve/reject buttons will throw ReferenceError and pending product list always shows empty state even when API returns data.

ui_bugs.issue: pendingProducts state is declared (line 38) but NEVER populated. fetchData() only calls /admin/users and /admin/stats, never /admin/products/pending. Result: 'Pending Products' tab always shows 'No pending products' even when API has pending items (verified: GET /api/admin/products/pending returns the test product, UI still shows 'No pending products'). Also the red count badge never appears.

handleModerate(p.id, 'approve'|'reject') referenced on lines 405/413 but function is NOT DEFINED anywhere in the file. Clicking Approve/Reject will throw ReferenceError: handleModerate is not defined, so moderation cannot work from UI.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend never calls GET /api/admin/products/pending on login/tab-switch, and never calls POST /api/admin/products/{id}/moderate. Entire admin moderation flow is broken end-to-end.

action_items: AdminDashboardPage.js: fetch GET /api/admin/products/pending (with X-Admin-Password header) inside fetchData() and call setPendingProducts(res.data.products). Also re-fetch after each approve/reject.

AdminDashboardPage.js: Define handleModerate(productId, action) to POST /api/admin/products/{productId}/moderate?action={action} with X-Admin-Password header, setModerating state before/after, remove product from list on success, show toast.
Optional: recompute tab badge count from pendingProducts.length after fetch.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboardPage: two undefined references (handleModerate, and missing setPendingProducts call path) show the moderation UI was wired visually but never connected. A simple first-load check or lint with no-undef would have caught handleModerate.

Backend multi-sig _vote_withdrawal: rejection threshold logic `len(rejections) > sig_count - needed` is correct for the 2-of-3 / 2-of-2 / 1-of-1 cases (verified in tests) but comment could be clearer.
Withdrawal create endpoint falls back to `[stokvel.created_by]` when no signatories set — good default, documented and tested.
StokvelDetailPage.js is approaching 1000 lines with 3 modals in one file — consider splitting the modals into sub-components.

success_rate.frontend: Admin tabs toggle works, RegionalHubsPage uses shadcn Select as required, StokvelDetailPage renders. BUT admin moderation flow is BROKEN (missing fetch + undefined handler).

rca of the issue: AdminDashboardPage.js: P1 feature #3 (Admin moderation UI) was implemented visually (JSX, tabs, testids, buttons, count badge) but two wiring pieces are missing: (1) fetchData() on line 85 never hits /admin/products/pending and never calls setPendingProducts, so the list stays empty. (2) handleModerate invoked on lines 405/413 is never declared; runtime will throw ReferenceError the moment a user clicks Approve/Reject. Reproduction: login to /admin with NetworkCapital2025!, create a pending product via API, click 'Pending Products' tab — UI shows 'No pending products' despite API returning 1 record. Mitigation: add inside fetchData: `const pp = await axiosInstance.get('/admin/products/pending', adminHeaders); setPendingProducts(pp.data.products || []);` and define a handleModerate async function that POSTs to /admin/products/{id}/moderate?action=... with X-Admin-Password header, then filters the product out of state on success.
